remarks: Contemporary three-story estate located in a lush private setting in coveted Mandeville Canyon. Amazing open floor plan with high ceilings and walls of glass that open to the serene backyard so you can enjoy indoor-outdoor living. The first level includes 2 ensuite bedrooms. The Second level has the grand living room, seamlessly flowing into a large gourmet kitchen, with all updated appliances, dining area and family room. The primary suite is on its own level with a perfectly positioned stone patio and an observation deck overlooking the pool and the surrounding beautiful canyon.
